title: Act: Clear non-matching focus and call applyFocusedObject from onStateChange
summary: Blur other focused objects and apply store focus on every store change
description: Extend applyFocusedObject to blur focused objects that do not match (all of them when id is null) and call it from onStateChange with useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId before the null-state early return.
acceptance_criteria: With focusedObjectId null, focused objects get blur() on store change
Focus application still runs when GameState is null
technical_constraints: Read focus from useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId; do not copy it into a scene field
definition_of_done: Store focus changes drive highlight and clear on null

steps.action: Add an else-if branch inside the forEach so that an object that isFocused and whose spec.id !== id gets blur() called.
steps.code:
if (id !== null && o.spec.id === id) { if (!o.isFocused) o.focus(); }
else if (o.isFocused) o.blur();
steps.expected: Null or non-matching id blurs previously focused objects

steps.action: Insert this.applyFocusedObject(useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId) as the first statement, before const state = this.readState() and its early return.
steps.expected: Every store notification applies the store focus to the scene objects
